sentences.english: The estate included a mansion and gardens.
sentences.japanese: その地所には邸宅と庭園が含まれていた。

sentences.english: Estate taxes can be quite significant.
sentences.japanese: 相続税はかなり大きな額になることがある。

sentences.english: The estate was divided among the heirs.
sentences.japanese: 財産は相続人に分割された。

sentences.english: Investing in commercial real estate can be profitable.
sentences.japanese: 商業不動産への投資は収益性が高い。

sentences.english: The estate planning attorney reviewed the will.
sentences.japanese: 遺産計画の弁護士が遺言を確認した。

sentences.english: A well-maintained estate holds its value over time.
sentences.japanese: よく整備された地所は時間が経っても価値を保つ。

sentences.english: The estate sale attracted many buyers.
sentences.japanese: 遺産品のセールには多くの買い手が集まった。

sentences.english: Real estate is often seen as a safe investment.
sentences.japanese: 不動産はしばしば安全な投資と見なされる。

sentences.english: The estate had been in the family for centuries.
sentences.japanese: その地所は何世紀にもわたって一族の所有だった。

sentences.english: She works as a real estate consultant.
sentences.japanese: 彼女は不動産コンサルタントとして働いている。

sentences.english: The estate was transformed into a hotel.
sentences.japanese: その地所はホテルに生まれ変わった。

sentences.english: Managing an estate requires careful financial planning.
sentences.japanese: 財産の管理には慎重な財務計画が必要だ。

sentences.english: The estate auction drew international interest.
sentences.japanese: その地所のオークションは国際的な関心を集めた。

sentences.english: Education is the best investment you can make.
sentences.japanese: 教育はあなたができる最良の投資だ。

sentences.english: She made a wise investment in the stock market.
sentences.japanese: 彼女は株式市場で賢明な投資をした。

sentences.english: The investment paid off after several years.
sentences.japanese: その投資は数年後に実を結んだ。

sentences.english: A good investment requires research and patience.
sentences.japanese: 良い投資には調査と忍耐が必要だ。

sentences.english: He lost a significant amount of money on bad investments.
sentences.japanese: 彼は悪い投資で多額のお金を失った。

sentences.english: The company announced a major investment in technology.
sentences.japanese: 会社はテクノロジーへの大規模投資を発表した。

sentences.english: Investment in renewable energy is growing rapidly.
sentences.japanese: 再生可能エネルギーへの投資は急速に成長している。

sentences.english: She diversified her investment portfolio.
sentences.japanese: 彼女は投資ポートフォリオを分散させた。

sentences.english: Long-term investments tend to yield higher returns.
sentences.japanese: 長期投資はより高いリターンをもたらす傾向がある。

sentences.english: The government increased investment in healthcare.
sentences.japanese: 政府は医療への投資を増やした。

sentences.english: Investment risk should be carefully evaluated.
sentences.japanese: 投資リスクは慎重に評価されるべきだ。

sentences.english: Her investment in self-improvement paid dividends.
sentences.japanese: 自己啓発への投資は多くの利益をもたらした。

sentences.english: The startup attracted significant foreign investment.
sentences.japanese: そのスタートアップは多くの外国投資を引きつけた。

sentences.english: Investment in infrastructure is crucial for development.
sentences.japanese: インフラへの投資は開発に不可欠だ。

sentences.english: He consulted a financial advisor about his investments.
sentences.japanese: 彼は投資について財務アドバイザーに相談した。

sentences.english: Time is also a valuable form of investment.
sentences.japanese: 時間も価値ある投資の一形態だ。

sentences.english: Mutual funds allow small investors to diversify.
sentences.japanese: 投資信託により小規模投資家も分散投資が可能だ。

sentences.english: The return on investment exceeded expectations.
sentences.japanese: 投資収益率は期待を上回った。

sentences.english: Investment in early childhood education yields long-term benefits.
sentences.japanese: 幼児教育への投資は長期的な恩恵をもたらす。

sentences.english: A poor investment can take years to recover from.
sentences.japanese: 悪い投資から回復するには何年もかかることがある。

sentences.english: Trust is the foundation of any relationship.
sentences.japanese: 信頼はあらゆる関係の基盤だ。

sentences.english: She earned his trust over many years.
sentences.japanese: 彼女は長年かけて彼の信頼を得た。

sentences.english: Once broken, trust is hard to rebuild.
sentences.japanese: 一度壊れた信頼は再構築が難しい。

sentences.english: I trust you to handle this situation.
sentences.japanese: あなたがこの状況を処理すると信頼しています。

sentences.english: The trust between colleagues boosts productivity.
sentences.japanese: 同僚間の信頼は生産性を高める。

sentences.english: He set up a trust fund for his children.
sentences.japanese: 彼は子どもたちのために信託基金を設立した。

sentences.english: Trust your instincts when making decisions.
sentences.japanese: 決断を下す際は本能を信頼しなさい。

sentences.english: The trust fund will support her education.
sentences.japanese: その信託基金は彼女の教育を支援する。

sentences.english: Building trust takes time but losing it is instant.
sentences.japanese: 信頼を築くには時間がかかるが、失うのは一瞬だ。

sentences.english: She placed her trust in the medical team.
sentences.japanese: 彼女は医療チームに信頼を置いた。

sentences.english: Trust is essential in business partnerships.
sentences.japanese: 信頼はビジネスパートナーシップに不可欠だ。

sentences.english: He managed the charitable trust with integrity.
sentences.japanese: 彼は誠実さをもって慈善信託を管理した。

sentences.english: Do you trust this source of information?
sentences.japanese: この情報源を信頼していますか？

sentences.english: A breach of trust can damage relationships permanently.
sentences.japanese: 信頼の侵害は関係を永久に損なうことがある。

sentences.english: The new employee quickly gained the team's trust.
sentences.japanese: 新入社員はすぐにチームの信頼を得た。

sentences.english: Trust in government institutions has declined.
sentences.japanese: 政府機関への信頼が低下している。

sentences.english: She learned to trust herself more over time.
sentences.japanese: 彼女は時間をかけて自分をより信頼することを学んだ。

sentences.english: A real estate investment trust diversifies property holdings.
sentences.japanese: 不動産投資信託は不動産保有を分散させる。

sentences.english: Parents must trust their children to make good choices.
sentences.japanese: 親は子どもが良い選択をすると信頼しなければならない。

sentences.english: Trust is built through consistent and honest actions.
sentences.japanese: 信頼は一貫した誠実な行動を通じて築かれる。
